## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      7 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Feb 26, 2026 - Jul 27, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _kristhom331_, Jul 27, 2026, 1/5: "This whole entire app is a big buggy mess"
            2. _Freyia Anderson_, May 27, 2026, 1/5: "I really like that it writes long messages but the app is very slow. Which I would still be okay with. But my chat messages and the AI messages randomly disappear and then the bot reacts to a message I have send about 5 messages before, getting back into the story. Doesn’t make any sense."
            3. _Arthur_2_, Jun 29, 2026, 2/5: "Has a massive issue with bugs, especially in between updates, some updates make the app worse for some time before getting patched. Also the filtering is pretty bad since there still is inappropriate content with underage characters. And in general, as with all of those apps it is extremely easy to get addicted to, especially with no message filtering. 2 points for the customisation options, profiles are fully customisable but you will need to learn to code to really get wild with it. The new pay to get feature sucks as well, most users already have proxy since the JJML just sucks. And yet they still ask for an outrageous amount of money for a better version of the JJML that can’t even generate a character stuttering without crashing."
